Peace is the foundation of every Goal.
The SDGs are about transformation, not business as usual.
Transformations require long-term investments.
Long-term investments require long-term plans.
The scale of action is regional and local, not only national.
Finance is decisive – global public goods require global finance
Dangerous technologies require global governance.
The UN must be for all – and that means on all continents
